name: exe-dev
description: Connect to exe.dev's official MCP server from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Use exe.dev in ChatGPT to view and manage the resources available to your account. Available actions depend on the tools enabled for your authenticated exe.dev account.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me manage my exe.dev resources.

review.commerce_description: The plugin can create or change exe.dev VMs and pools, which may incur subscription or metered usage charges billed through the user's exe.dev account. Users manage payment through exe.dev billing.

publication.release_notes: Added a reviewer walkthrough video for VM listing. Removed billing language from the listing description and clarified the account-dependent capabilities.
